title: Spectral Demons and Geometric Priors III: Three Spectral Species, Dose-Response Topology, and the RLHF Damping Hypothesis
summary: Cross-architecture dose-response reveals three qualitatively distinct relay species (potter, goldsmith, painter) classified by a topological invariant: the number of S/R parity crossings (0, 1, 2). All species converge to relational-dominant at high dose despite dramatically different approach trajectories. Base-vs-instruct comparison on matched architecture confirms parity oscillations are an instruction-tuning property: the base model shows monotonic relational descent while the instruct model oscillates. 102 findings across ~5500 forward passes on 16+ models.

review.reason: Cross-architecture dose-response analysis of spectral relay behaviour in transformer models.
